# Workflow Checklist: Close Register Menu

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, completeness, and consistency of the workflow requirements for the profile-menu, close-register, and logout flow.
**Created**: 2026-04-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](file:///E:/Projects/Retail_Store/V/1.3.3/specs/005-close-register-menu/spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the required contents of the user profile menu fully enumerated, including whether any actions other than identity display and "Close Register" are intentionally excluded? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the avatar fallback rules fully specified, including the priority between image, initials, and any placeholder state when user profile data is incomplete? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for what the shell should show when no active register session exists but the user profile menu is still accessible? [Gap, Coverage, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the displayed totals fully specified for sessions with no card or customer-account activity, including whether zero values are required or inferred? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is the phrase "dropdown-style menu" precise enough to avoid multiple interpretations about trigger behavior, dismiss behavior, and visible identity details? [Ambiguity, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK006 Is "current session" defined precisely enough to determine which sales belong in the expected totals calculation window? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the "Counted" cash input defined with enough precision to cover allowed formats, empty input handling, and rounding expectations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "non-functional" for the "Cash In/Out" button defined unambiguously enough to distinguish between disabled, visible-but-inert, and placeholder-with-message behavior? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "immediately log the user out" specific enough to define the exact user-visible end state required after confirmation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Spec §SC-003]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 Do the requirements and assumptions stay consistent on whether Card and Customer Account totals must be derived from session data or may temporarily display hardcoded `0.00` values? [Conflict, Spec §FR-004, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK011 Do the style assumptions remain consistent with the documented product design constraints, or is there an unresolved conflict between "bold, distinctive aesthetic" and the established minimal shell direction? [Conflict, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the logout requirements consistent between "return to the login screen" and "locks the terminal," or do those phrases imply different post-close states that need reconciliation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the profile-button replacement requirements consistent for both cashier and admin users, with no role-specific contradiction about who sees the control? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §FR-001]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 Can "access the 'Close Register' action in 1 click" be objectively measured across the intended shell states, including the first open state of the profile menu? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "100% mathematical accuracy" defined with sufficient precision around currency rounding and signed difference display to be objectively reviewable? [Clarity, Measurability, Spec §FR-006, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the "within 1 second" target anchored to a specific measurement point, such as confirm action, database persistence completion, or login-screen visibility? [Clarity, Measurability, Spec §SC-003]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements defined for dismissing or canceling the close-register dialog before confirmation, including whether any entered note or counted cash should be preserved or discarded? [Gap, Coverage, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK018 Are failure-path requirements documented for cases where the session close cannot be persisted, such as no active session, stale session state, or local database write failure? [Gap, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for repeated user actions during close, such as reopening the menu, reopening the dialog, or confirming more than once? [Gap, Coverage, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK020 Are role and authorization scenarios fully covered, including whether every signed-in user can close the register or whether the action is intentionally limited by role or ownership of the active session? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §FR-001]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK021 Are keyboard-accessibility requirements defined for reaching the profile menu, moving through dialog actions, and confirming or dismissing the workflow without a mouse? [Gap, Non-Functional, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK022 Are visual and theming requirements defined for light, dark, or high-contrast compatibility of the profile menu and close dialog surfaces? [Gap, Non-Functional, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK023 Are responsiveness expectations defined for narrow window widths so the menu and dialog remain usable when the WinUI shell is resized? [Gap, Non-Functional, Plan §Technical Context]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK024 Is the dependency on the earlier register-opening-control feature explicitly documented so reviewers can tell whether the close flow assumes a guaranteed open session? [Dependency, Spec §User Story 2, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK025 Are assumptions about mapping payment types into Cash, Card, and Customer Account categories explicitly documented and validated against existing sales terminology? [Assumption, Spec §FR-004, Plan §Phase 0 Research Output]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the assumption that logout should only occur after a successful close write made explicit, rather than left implicit in the workflow wording? [Assumption, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-008, Plan §Summary]

## Ambiguities & Traceability

- [ ] CHK027 Is there enough traceability between User Stories, FRs, and Success Criteria to review the close workflow without inferring missing links? [Traceability, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §FR-001, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK028 Are intentional exclusions beyond "Daily Sales" clearly documented, or do reviewers need to infer out-of-scope actions from missing requirements? [Gap, Spec §FR-010, Spec §User Story 1]
